audience: Europe-based B2B AI SaaS founders, 10–50 people, Seed–Series B; founder-led LinkedIn. Audience/context only, no guarantee of reach, demand or conversion.
evidence_basis: 279 V5 fulltext interpretation rows; official LinkedIn guidance and systems descriptions; peer-reviewed/first-party research where available; original angles are hypotheses, not copied post adaptations.
principles: Make the post about a recognizable professional problem and one useful point. LinkedIn describes feed matching as personalized to professional interests and member history; semantic topical clarity is a sensible content design principle, not an algorithm exploit.

Balance educational/experience evidence and offer posts. V5 sample has 91 teach-method, 63 offer, 46 belief-challenge, 36 story and 23 proof; sample is curated public references, not an optimal ratio.
Use first-person only where the founder can verify the experience. Use synthetic examples explicitly labeled as such. No invented customers, results, case evidence or tool experience.

Pick format for the communication job: plain text for a crisp argument, image for an inspectable diagram, native video for a demonstrated workflow, document for a reference artifact. V5 cross-format comparison is observational and confounded.
For videos, use a clear first frame, one sequence, spoken/caption alignment and manual caption review. Captions aid accessibility; no performance lift promised.
Use a specific CTA tied to reader utility: save/checklist, ask a sincere question, review a method, or visit a relevant page. Avoid bait, automation and coordinated engagement.

Measure on owner analytics where available: impressions/reach, in/out-of-network discovery, profile activity, link clicks, watch time/completion if provided, relevant comments, and qualified site actions. Log timing/copy/format/offer and audience context. Do not infer reach or sales from public reactions.

20_original_angles.title: Positioning before workshop
20_original_angles.concept: Show real pre-work decision sequence: buyer, job, alternatives, scope. Test checklist text vs simple diagram.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Saves a team from workshop churn; grounded in actual client experience or clearly framed as method.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Qualified replies from founders/marketing leaders; saves; profile activity.

20_original_angles.title: Founder phrase vs buyer phrase
20_original_angles.concept: Use an approved, anonymized real wording shift with source and context; no invented client quote.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Make one phrase concrete and disclose whether it is observed or a hypothetical example.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Substantive comments; qualified profile visits; buyer language echoed.

20_original_angles.title: AI output is not strategy
20_original_angles.concept: Demonstrate same weak brief through generic AI output and a human-defined brief; use synthetic example.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Show the prompt/context and limits; avoid claiming a tool universally fails.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Relevant comments; saves; demo requests with source attribution.

20_original_angles.title: A bounded AI workflow teardown
20_original_angles.concept: Walk through task, model/tool role, human check, failure mode and handoff using non-sensitive synthetic data.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Make reviewer role and output inspectable; avoid unsupported efficiency claims.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; qualified comments; downstream clicks.

20_original_angles.title: The measurement you can defend
20_original_angles.concept: Separate impressions, reach, clicks, reactions, leads; show a miniature measurement tree.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Name denominator, period and what counter cannot prove.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Click-through and qualified conversion; not reaction count alone.

20_original_angles.title: The founder channel trade-off
20_original_angles.concept: Describe one real founder decision between hiring, founder time and distribution; actual outcome only.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Include date/context and rejected path; no fictional first-person experience.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Thoughtful founder replies; profile activity; referral source.

20_original_angles.title: What we changed after a buyer objection
20_original_angles.concept: Use a verified objection and what evidence changed the offer/message; anonymize only with permission.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Keep objection verbatim only if authorized; distinguish one case from a pattern.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Qualified comments; discovery calls attributable to post.

20_original_angles.title: A homepage has one job
20_original_angles.concept: Contrast homepage promise, sales deck and onboarding jobs using owned material.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: No claims about client conversion without data.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; target buyer comments; measured tagged visits.

20_original_angles.title: Where AI automation should stop
20_original_angles.concept: Map an automation boundary: repetitive, reversible tasks vs judgment/context decisions.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Include a concrete failure case that is true or explicitly hypothetical.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Replies on workflow boundaries; qualified inquiries.

20_original_angles.title: A 5-minute message audit
20_original_angles.concept: Offer a three-question audit for clarity: audience, pain, alternative. Use an original mock.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Mark mock as illustrative; do not claim benchmark validation.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; profile views; opt-in audit requests.

20_original_angles.title: Tool review with a real test
20_original_angles.concept: Review one AI/SaaS tool against a stated task, inputs, date, criteria, failure and cost.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Hands-on test must be real, dated and reproducible; disclose product version.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Qualified comments; click-outs; search/profile activity.

20_original_angles.title: Tool choice: when not to buy
20_original_angles.concept: Decision tree for build/buy/manual based on frequency, risk, integration and upkeep.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: State assumptions and when the decision changes.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; comments from operators; qualified calls.

20_original_angles.title: A product demo showing a failure
20_original_angles.concept: Short native video: task, expected behavior, failure, fix/limit. Pair with accurate captions.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Only actual product state; no fabricated customer data/results.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Video completion/watch time; qualified clicks; substantive comments.

20_original_angles.title: Why the offer is narrow
20_original_angles.concept: Explain a real scope boundary, intended customer and excluded work.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Use approved service wording/prices; no unsupported superiority claim.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Qualified lead fit; calls from target segment.

20_original_angles.title: How a founder turns notes into a post
20_original_angles.concept: Show process with synthetic/redacted notes and the human editing decisions.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: No private buyer notes; disclose synthetic material.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; comments on process; profile follows from relevant roles.

20_original_angles.title: A buyer-risk checklist for AI SaaS
20_original_angles.concept: Checklist spanning data, reliability, workflow, ownership, ROI measurement.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Reference each factual/security claim; no legal/security assurance.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; professional comments; tagged resource clicks.

20_original_angles.title: One metric that changed the decision
20_original_angles.concept: Use owner-approved actual metric with source, baseline, timeframe, sample and caveat.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: If proof not available, do not invent; convert to a question/method draft.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Qualified engagement and attributable site/action, not likes.

20_original_angles.title: A recurring build note
20_original_angles.concept: Short update with what shipped, what failed, next decision; recurring only if sustainable.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Only verified company progress; avoid implied roadmap promises.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Relevant followers; substantive replies; return readers.

20_original_angles.title: A useful disagreement in AI marketing
20_original_angles.concept: State a scoped position and one evidence-backed counterpoint; ask a genuine decision question.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Avoid vote-bait, “comment to agree,” forced binary, tagging bait.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Substantive answer rate; new qualified commenters.

20_original_angles.title: Buyer language glossary
20_original_angles.concept: Explain one confusing term and contrast it with the buyer’s actual job.
20_original_angles.evidence_guardrail: Source claims and avoid semantic/search ranking promises.
20_original_angles.observable_metrics: Saves; search appearances; buyer phrasing in inquiries.

test_design.unit: Post; one owner-account publication is the observational unit.
test_design.design: Pre-register a small balanced sequence across teaching, story, challenge, proof and offer; rotate format within message class when feasible. Avoid changing format/topic/CTA/length simultaneously. Use repeated replications because one post is noisy.
test_design.baseline: Collect owner analytics at fixed windows (e.g. 24h and 7d) with post ID, timestamp, format, topic, editorial job, CTA, impressions/reach, out-of-network share if surfaced, social interactions, profile activity, link clicks, qualified visits/leads with UTM where available. Record missing values as missing.
primary_outcomes: qualified actions per 1,000 impressions where denominator exists
qualified profile activity / relevant profile views
link click-through and qualified site action
test_design.analysis: Report per-post values and medians/ranges by predeclared cell; include denominator and missingness. Do not treat public visible reactions as impressions, unique people, buyer quality or conversion. Do not call three posts a trend. Keep same-account comparisons and note platform changes.
test_design.decision_rule: Adopt only a repeatable pattern that improves a predeclared buyer-relevant outcome across replications without degrading evidence quality or voice. Treat ambiguous results as inconclusive.
